name: m4-int00e3bb-promo
description: G1 promotion census of the perf integration tip `00e3bbafb8` on the scala corpus (M4): which classes are promoted to survivor and tenured space, to explain why 62% of GC-thread cycles in `m4-int00e3bb-prof` scan dirty cards (old-to-young pointers) and young pauses take 120-190 ms.
Same build, JDK, heap and iterations as `m4-int00e3bb-prof` (async cpu+alloc), with the promotion and tenuring JFR events added to the lab's .jfc.
